description: This script manages external web dependencies for a project, including downloading and installing packages, with a WebDependency class handling package details and extraction logic.

classes.name: WebDependency
classes.description: Represents a web dependency package, handling its download, extraction, and path configurations.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor for WebDependency, initializes package details and prepares extraction paths.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the dependency package.

methods.name: url
methods.description: Returns the URL of the dependency package.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Returns the version of the dependency package.

methods.name: ff
methods.description: Returns the File::Fetch object associated with the package.

methods.name: extract_paths
methods.description: Returns the list of paths to extract from the archive.

methods.name: archive_name
methods.description: Returns the filename of the archive to be downloaded.

methods.name: print_command
methods.description: Prints a formatted command message for actions like downloading or installing.

methods.name: print_status
methods.description: Prints the status message with color coding.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Fetches the package archive to a specified directory.

methods.name: extract
methods.description: Extracts the archive contents into the target directory, handling different formats.
